title: Bookmarks
subtitle: Design your own bookmark from your picture, from a pattern, or as a whole set. You see it straight away, and we 3D print it.

design.heading: Settings
design.engineError: The designer could not load. Reload the page or write to us.
design.previewError: The preview failed. Try another picture or setting.

picture.heading: Picture
picture.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to {maxMb} MB. The picture stays in your browser and is not uploaded anywhere.
picture.tooLarge: The picture is over {maxMb} MB. Choose a smaller one.
picture.wrongType: That file is not a JPG, PNG or WebP.
picture.needed: Upload a picture to see your bookmark.

colours.heading: Colours
colours.hintPicture: Picked from your picture. Change any of them freely.
colours.hintPattern: How many colours you need depends on the pattern style.

set.heading: Set
set.splitHint: The picture is split across the bookmarks, so together they make one big picture.
set.picturesHint: Up to {max} bookmarks, each with its own picture. Add the pictures one by one: all of them show in the preview.
set.namesHint: The same design for all, with a different name on each bookmark.

privacy.heading: Your picture stays with you
privacy.text: The picture is processed in your browser, never uploaded or stored, and disappears when you close the page. The order only sends a file with your settings and a simplified few-colour version of the picture, together with your contact details.

warnings.NAME_DOES_NOT_FIT: The name does not fit. Make it shorter, or choose a narrower font or a wider bookmark.
warnings.NAME_FONT_MISSING_LETTERS: The font is missing some letters of the name. Choose another font.
warnings.NAME_NO_CONTRAST: The name will be hard to read: the colours are too close. Choose a lighter or darker colour.
warnings.NAME_BOOKMARK_NARROW: Only very short names fit on a bookmark this narrow.
warnings.DETAIL_SIMPLIFIED: Some detail was too fine to print and has been simplified.
warnings.BRIDGES_ADDED: Thin bridges were added to hold loose parts in place.
warnings.NOTHING_TO_PRINT: Nothing is left to print: the picture is too faint or too fine for these colours.
warnings.HOLE_NO_ROOM: There is no room for the hanging hole in this shape and size, so the bookmark has none.
warnings.SIZE_NARROW: A very narrow bookmark: names must be short and fine picture detail is lost.
warnings.SIZE_SHORT: A very short bookmark: there is little room for the picture and the name.
warnings.PICTURE_COLOURS_IGNORED: The set uses the same colours for every picture.

errors.namesNeedBack: A name on a cut-through pattern has nothing to sit on. Choose the “Raised” style or remove the name.
errors.PICTURE_UNREADABLE: The picture cannot be read. Try a JPG, PNG or WebP.
errors.PICTURE_TOO_LARGE: The picture is too large. Try a smaller one.
errors.SIZE_OUT_OF_RANGE: That size cannot be made. Choose another.
